THIS UNILATERAL UNDERTAKING is dated
AND IS GIVEN BY:
PHILIP GEORGE GIBSON AND CHRISTINE IRIS GIBSON of 1 OrWell
Spike, West Malling, Kent ME19 4PB (the "First Owner");
MARK STEPHEN EYRE AND JOANNE EYRE of Woodside, 2 Orwell Spike,
West Malling, Kent ME19 4PB (the "Second Owner");
Together (the "Owner"); and
FERNHAM HOMES LIMITED (Company Registration Number 03778310)
whose registered office is at 68 Grafton Way, London W1T 5DS (the
"Appellant")
TO:
TONBRIDGE & MALLING BOROUGH COUNCIL of GibSon Building, Gibson
Drive, Kings Hil, West Malling, Kent, ME19 4LZ (the "Council").
BACKGROUND
The Council is the Local Planning Authority for the purposes of the Act for the
area within which the Site is situated and is entitled to enforce the obligations
in this Deed;
The First Owner is the freehold owner of that part of the Site shown hatched
green on the Site Plan being part of land registered at the Land Registry with
title absolute under title number K777266 and known as 1 Orwell Spike, West
Malling ME19 4PB (the "First Property");
The Second Owner is the freehold owner of that part of the Site shown hatched
purple on the Site Plan being part of land registered at the Land Registry with
title absolute under title number K776389 and known as 2 Orwell Spike, West
Malling ME19 4PB (the "Second Property");
The Appellant has an interest in the Site by way of a sale and purchase
agreement dated 17th July 2020;
The Application was submitted to the Council by the Appellant on 2nd October
2020 and validated by the Council on 7th October 2020 under reference
A viability assessment was requested by the Council after the Application was
validated as the Development was not able to meet the level of requisite
financial contributions;
The Viability Assessment was submitted to the Council on 9th November 2020;
An Affordable Housing commuted sum was requested in the Council's
delegated report dated 30th April 2020 (the "Delegated Report") in lieu of the
provision of 4 Affordable Housing units on the Site as part of the Development
together with a leisure contribution in the sum of £44, 195.00
In the Delegated Report Kent County Council requested education
contributions totalling £174,216.84, a community learning contribution in the
sum of £147.78, a youth service contribution in the sum of £589.50, a lrary
bookstock contribution in the sum of £499.05, a social care contribution in the
sum of £1,321.92 and a waste contribution in the sum of £1,653.03
The Application was refused by delegated powers on 30th April 2021
The Appeal by the Appellant was lodged against the refusal of the Application
on 16th July 2021 and validated on 10th August 2021 under appeal reference
The Owner and the Appellant are willing to enter into this Deed in the terms
and subject to the conditions hereinafter appearing which the Relevant Parties
put forward as material considerations in the determination of the Application
at Appeal.
The Appellant has attempted to consult with the Council in an effort to agree
the terms of this Deed with them but they have declined to engage.

provisions to remain at an affordable
price for future eligible households or for
the subsidy to be recycled for alternative
affordable housing provisions.

Any covenant not to do any act or thing shall be deemed to include an obligation
not to permit or suffer such act or thing to be done by another person where
knowledge of the actions of the other person is reasonably to be inferred.
Any references to any particular statute include any statutory extension,
modification, amendment or re-enactment of such statute and also include any
subordinate instruments, regulations or orders made in pursuance of it.
Words importing the singular meaning where the context so admits include the
plural meaning and vice versa.
Words of the masculine gender include the feminine and neuter genders and
words denoting actual persons include companies, corporations and firms and
all such words shall be construed interchangeably in that manner.
Where under this Deed any notice, approval, consent, certificate, direction,
authority, agreement, action, expression of satisfaction is required to be given
or reached or taken by any party or any response is requested any such notice,
approval, consent, certificate, direction, authority, agreement action,
expression of satisfaction or response shall not be unreasonable or
unreasonably withheld or delayed.
The headings appearing in this Deed are for ease of reference only and shall
not affect the construction of this Deed.
Where reference is made to a Clause, Part, Plan, Paragraph, Recital or
Schedule such reference (unless the context requires otherwise) is a reference
to a clause, part, plan, paragraph, recital or schedule of or to (or in the case of
the Site Plan attached to) this Deed.
References to the Owner or the Appellant shall include the Owner's or the
Appellant's successors in title and to any deriving title through or under that
party;
Any dispute between the Relevant Parties (other than a dispute relating to a
matter of law or in relation to the construction or interpretation of this Deed
which will be subject to the jurisdiction of the Courts) shall be determined in
accordance with Clause 10 of this Deed
This Deed shall take effect on the satisfaction of all of the conditions referred
to in Clause 3
1.12 Nothing in this Deed shall be construed as affecting prohibiting or limiting any
rights to develop any part of the Site in accordance with any other planning
permission granted whether before or after the date of this Deed by the Council
or the by the Secretary of State for Communities and Local Government or any
other competent authority and the terms of any planning obligation relating
thereto
. If any provision or part of any provision in this Deed shall be held to be invalid
illegal or unenforceable the validity legality and enforceability of the remaining
provisions or part of the provisions hereof shall not in any way be deemed
thereby to be affected or impaired
1.14 Nothing in this Deed shall operate to prevent the grant of a mortgage or charge
over any part of the Site or the Development
Nothing in this Deed shall prevent or preclude or inhibit the diversion laying
repair replacement maintenance improvement connection to and use of
infrastructure services and service media in on under or over any part of the
Site and the right of the Owner any utility company or service provider to
preclude access to the Site during the course of any such operations and during
the course of any subsequent reinstatement
Nothing in this Deed shall prevent the sale or disposal of any interest in any
part of the Site to another company body developer or investor PRoviDED
ALWAYs THAT in so far as they remain to be performed the restrictions
covenants and obligations contained in this Deed shall (save as otherwise
provided for in Clauses 4 and 5) run with the land and shall continue to bind
such successors in title of the original Owner.
LEGAL EFFECT
This Deed is entered into pursuant to:-
Section 106 of the Act (as amended); and
all other enabling powers that may be relevant to the enforcement of
the obligations contained in this Deed.
The obligations shall be enforceable not only against the Owner but also
against their successors in title and assigns and those deriving title under them,
provided that neither the Owner nor its successors in title and assigns shall be
liable for any breach of any covenant contained in this Deed after it has parted
with all its interest in that part of the Site to which the breach relates except in
relation to any antecedent breach prior to parting with such interest and
provided further that the obligations in this Deed shall not be enforceable
against:
the buyers tenants or occupiers of any Dwellings erected on the Site
and/or against their successors in title and their mortgagees or
chargees (or any receiver appointed by any such mortgagee) and any
person who is a successor in title or derives title through or under any
such mortgagee chargee or receiver;
a statutory undertaker utility company or service provider (including the
operators of any district heating combined heat and power solar
photovoltaic or renewable energy systems) after the transfer dedication
lease licence or grant of rights easements and or wayleaves by the
Owner or the Appellant to the statutory undertaker utility company or
service provider of the services service media and/or buildings works
apparatus and/or equipment any land upon or within and/or over which
the said services service media and/or buildings works apparatus
and/or equipment is situated;
a tenant licensee or other provider of photovoltaic panels or other
renewable energy systems; or
any person company or authority which acquires rights over or becomes
proprietor of any land on the Site for the purposes of providing services
or facilities in connection with the Development and their successors in
title or assigns;
The Owner's obligations in this Deed are conditional on both the grant of the
Planning Permission and the Commencement Date having occurred
If the Inspector in his or her appeal decision letter concludes that any of the
planning obligations terms and conditions (or any relevant part of any planning
obligation term or condition) in this Deed are incompatible with any one or more
of the tests for planning obligations as set out in Regulation 122 of the
Community Infrastructure Levy Regulations 2010 (as amended) or fail the tests
set out the National Planning Policy Framework dated July 2021 or are
otherwise unenforceable unlawful or invalid and/or he or she expressly
attaches no weight to that planning obligation term or condition or the relevant
part of that planning obligation term or condition in determining the appeal then
that planning obligation term or condition or the relevant part of that planning
obligation term or condition shall, from the date of the appeal decision letter,
immediately cease to have effect and no person shall be under any obligation
to comply with it PROVIDED ALWAYS THAT the remaining provisions or part
of the provisions hereof shall not in any way be deemed thereby to be affected
or impaired and shall remain in full force and effect
COMMENCEMENT
This Deed is conditional upon both:
the grant of the Planning Permission; and
the Commencement Date having occurred,
except for the provisions of this Clause Sub-Clause 4.1(b), Clause 14 and
Clause 15 and any provisions regarding the interpretation thereof which shall
come into effect immediately upon completion of this Deed
OWNER'S COVENANTS
The Owner hereby covenants with the Council:
to observe and perform and cause to be observed and performed the
covenants contained in Schedule 2 to this Deed;
other than in relation to disposals of any Dwellings or disposals
envisaged by Clause 2.2, to give the Council written notice within 5
Working Days of any change in ownership of any of its interests in the
Site occurring before all the obligations under this Deed have been
discharged such notice to give details of the transferee's full name and
registered office (if a company or usual address if not) together with a
plan showing the area of the Site purchased
GENERAL PROVISIONS
IT IS HEREBY DECLARED that:
The covenants to be observed and performed under this Deed shall be treated
as Local Land Charges and registrable at the Local Land Charges Registry for
the purposes of the Local Land Charges Act 1975; and
Nothing in this Deed shall prejudice or affect the rights powers duties and
obligations of the Council in the exercise by it of its statutory functions and the
rights powers duties and obligations of the Council under private or public
statutes bye-laws orders and regulations may be as fully and effectively
exercised as if it were not a party to this Deed.
WAIVER
No waiver (whether express or implied) by the Council of any breach or default
by the Owner in performing or observing any of the covenants undertakings
obligations or restrictions contained in this Deed shall constitute a continuing
waiver and no such waiver shall prevent the Council from enforcing any of the
said covenants undertakings obligations or restrictions or from acting upon any
subsequent breach or default by the Owner.
INTEREST
Without prejudice to any right remedy or power available to the Council, if any
payment of any sum referred to shall have become due but shall remain unpaid
for a period exceeding twenty one days, the Owner shall pay on demand to the
Council Interest thereon from the date when it becomes due until payment.
SEVERABILITY
Each Clause Sub-clause Schedule or paragraph shall be separate distinct and
severable from each other, to the extent only that if any of these becomes or is
invalid or shall be held by the Courts to be void but would be valid if severed
or any wording was deleted or any time period reduced or scope of activities or
area covered diminished, then any modifications necessary to ensure such
Clause Sub-clause Schedule or paragraph be valid shall apply without
prejudice to any other Clause Sub-clause Schedule or paragraph contained
in this Deed. The Schedules to this Deed are incorporated and form part of
this Deed.
MODIFICATIONS TO DEED AND SECTION 73 CONSENT
In the event of the planning obligations contained in this Deed being modified
the Owner and the Appellant agrees that a note or memorandum may be
endorsed on this Deed by the Council.
If any Section 73 Consent is granted after the date of this Deed:
9.2.1 the obligations in this Deed shall relate to and bind such Section 73
Consent; and
9.2.2 the definitions of Application, Development and Planning Permission
(other than for the purposes of clause 1) shall be construed to include
reference to (retrospectively) the planning application for the Section 73
Consent the development permitted by the Section 73 Consent and the
Section 73 Consent itself;
The Owner and the Appellant acknowledge that nothing in this clause shall
fetter the discretion of the Council in determining any planning application for a
Section 73 Consent and the appropriate planning obligations required in
connection with the determination of the same;
To the extent that any of the obligations in this Agreement have already been
discharged at the date that a Section 73 Consent is granted they shall remain
discharged for the purposes of the Section 73 Consent; and
The provisions of this clause shall not apply to any Section 73 Consent which
necessitates or requires amendments to the substantive terms or obligations
of or contained within this Deed.
RESOLUTION OF DISPUTES
10.1 Referral to the Expert
In the event of a dispute or difference arising between the Relevant Parties in
respect of any matter contained in this Deed (other than a dispute relating to a
matter of law or in relation to the construction or interpretation of this Deed
which will be subject to the jurisdiction of the courts) the matter in dispute wil
on the application of the Relevant Parties who are in dispute be referred to an
expert (the "Expert") for determination in accordance with the following
provisions:-
10.1.1 the Expert must have at least 10 years post qualification experience in
the subject matter of the dispute;
10.1.2 where such dispute relates to engineering construction or highway
works it will be referred to a chartered civil engineer agreed upon by the
Parties or in default of agreement within one month of notification of the
said dispute to the other party the Expert will be appointed by or at the
direction of the President for the time being of the Institution of Civil
Engineers; and
10.1.3 where such dispute relates to planning and related matters it will be
referred to a chartered town planner agreed upon by the Parties or in
default of the agreement within one month of notification of the said
dispute to the other party the Expert will be appointed by or at the
direction of the President for the time being of the Royal Town Planning
Institute
PROVIDED THAT the Relevant Parties who are in dispute may mutually agree
an alternative Expert appropriate to the nature of the dispute or to mediation as
an alternative form of dispute resolution
10.2 Procedure for the Resolution of Disputes
Unless otherwise agreed by the Relevant Parties who are in dispute (in their
absolute discretions) the Expert is to act as an independent expert and:
10.2.1 the Relevant Parties who are in dispute may make written
representations within 15 Working Days of the appointment of the
Expert and will copy the written representations to the other party;
10.2.2 the Relevant Parties who are in dispute are to have a further 10
Working Days to make written comments on the other party's
representations and will copy the written comments to the other party;
10.2.3 the Expert is to be at liberty to cal for such written evidence from the
parties and to seek such legal or other expert assistance as he may
reasonably require;
10.2.4 the Expert is not to take oral representations from the parties without
giving all parties the opportunity to be present and to give evidence and
to cross examine each other; and
10.2.5 the Expert must have regard to all representations and evidence before
him when making his decision, which is to be in writing, and must give
reasons for his decision within 20 Working Days of receipt of the final
representations from the parties or such longer period as may in their
absolute discretions be agreed between them
Costs of the Expert
Responsibility for the costs of the Expert under this clause 10, including costs
connected with the appointment of the Expert and the Expert's own costs, will
be decided by the Expert, failing which each Party will bear its own costs of
the reference and determination and one-half each of the Expert's costs.
NOTICES
The Owner or the Appellant shall give written notice to the Council at least 10
Working Days prior to the Commencement Date.
1. The provisions of Section 196 of the Law of Property Act 1925 (as amended)
shall apply to any notice or approval to be served under or in connection with
this Deed and any such notice to the:
(a) Council shall be in writing and addressed to the Director of Planning at
Tonbridge & Malling Borough Council Gibson Building, Gibson Drive, Kings
Hill, West Malling, Kent, ME19 4LZ and shall quote the reference number
referred to in the definition of "Application" in Clause 1.1 of this Deed and
shall state that the notice is served pursuant to this Deed.
(b) Owner shall be in writing and addressed to each individual Owner at the
addresses detailed above
The Appellant shall be in writing addressed to the Company Secretary, 426
Vale Road Tonbridge Kent TN9 1SW
REVOCATION
In the event that the Planning Permission is quashed lapses or is revoked or
otherwise withdrawn this Deed will cease to have any further force or effect
unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Council
CONTRACTS (RIGHTS OF THIRD PARTIES ACT) 1999
The Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act 1999 shall not apply to this Deed
and no one other than the Relevant Parties (and any of its servants successors
in title assigns or successor bodies) shall have any rights under or be able to
enforce the provisions of this Agreement.
JURISDICTION
This Deed is governed by and the parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of
the Courts of England and Wales interpreted in accordance with the law of
England and Wales.
DELIVERY
The provisions of this Deed (other than this Clause which shall be of immediate
effect) shall be of no effect until this Deed has been dated.
